panel_name: malaiwah Qwen3.8-27B suite v5, shard 0 -- 512 contexts

shard_aggregate.rule: sha256(concat of per-context token_sha256 hex in context_index order) == registry panel identity.panel_token_sha256

selection_rule: every context of the sealed shard, in the shard suite-manifest's context_index order; window N carries context_index[N]'s token ids verbatim. No RNG, no tokenizer, no re-derivation from text.

separation.method: inherited from the parent suite manifest
separation.note: Gutenberg / arXiv / Wikipedia (en + de,fr,es,ja,zh,ru) / CPython v3.12.8 Lib; calibration-overlapping documents are pre-excluded.

tokenizer.note: no tokenizer was loaded by this tool; token ids are transported from the sealed suite, so tokenizer identity is inherited from the suite manifest, not re-asserted.
